description: Mapping of Lexical playground files to local copies, packages holding Lexical version pins, and auto-discovery configuration

dependency-packages.description: Every package.json that pins Lexical versions. ALL of these must be bumped together in the same commit, otherwise the monorepo ends up on split Lexical versions.
dependency-packages.verify: After editing, no Lexical pin should reference the old version: grep -h 'lexical' <each package.json> | grep -c '<old-version>' must be 0
dependency-packages.note: Versions are pinned exactly (no ^ or ~). pnpm-workspace.yaml currently has no Lexical overrides - re-check on each upgrade.

auto-discover.description: Automatically discover files importing from @lexical packages

tracked-files.note: Used in ToolbarPlugin.tsx for determining selected node
Second copy of the same playground file, for react-components2. Kept byte-identical to the react-components copy - apply the same diff to both.

local-formatting.description: Our copies are reformatted by prettier/eslint, so they never match the playground byte-for-byte. Differences that are expected and must NOT be 'fixed' when syncing:
expected-differences: Prettier formatting (spacing inside braces, line width)
Import ordering enforced by our eslint config (@lexical/* sorted before lexical)
`import type` used for type-only imports (upstream adopted this in 0.47.0)
local-formatting.guidance: Compare semantics, not bytes. Diff the playground file between the two version tags and apply only that delta.

custom-nodes.description: Custom Lexical nodes that need validation after upgrades. All extend ElementNode or DecoratorBlockNode and use the classic static getType()/clone()/importJSON() protocol (not the newer $config() protocol).

editor-nodes.note: Editor version - handles admin entity links

react-components2-nodes.note: Shared by editor and display in react-components2
Shared by editor and display in react-components2
Shared by editor and display in react-components2

requiredMethods.name: createDOM
requiredMethods.signature: override createDOM(config: EditorConfig, editor?: LexicalEditor): HTMLElement

optionalMethods.name: afterCloneFrom
optionalMethods.note: Recommended if node has instance-specific state

optionalMethods.name: updateDOM
optionalMethods.signature: override updateDOM(prevNode: ThisType, dom: HTMLElement, config: EditorConfig): boolean
optionalMethods.note: Required if DOM needs updates when node changes

validation.watch-for: Lexical is migrating built-in nodes to the $config() protocol (#8640, landed in 0.49.0). ElementNode and DecoratorBlockNode were NOT migrated, so our nodes still use the static protocol. If a future release migrates those base classes, all 9 custom nodes above need porting.

known-file-groups.description: Lexical-importing files, verified against the tree as of Lexical 0.49.0

verification.description: Commands to run after bumping. The aggregate turbo tasks report FULL TURBO from cache, so force-run the Lexical-covering tests directly.
force-run-tests: cd libraries/react-components2 && pnpm vitest run src/components/richtext
verification.note: react-components2's richTextRoundTrip.test.ts serializes/deserializes every custom node, so it is the key regression check for node-protocol changes.

playground-repo.note: The remote is named 'upstream' (not 'origin'), and the checkout is usually on a detached HEAD at an old tag. Fetch tags with `git fetch upstream --tags` before diffing; do not assume `git fetch --dry-run` or a branch check will work.
